purpose: Provider adapter boundary for real environmental reporting. This registry defines transport and provenance contracts; it does not fabricate or simulate live observations.

providers.status_rule: Never label forecast/model output as OBSERVED.
Provider output remains MODELLED unless the source contract explicitly identifies another data class.

providers.activation: Requires authorized instrument deployment and station identity.

providers.status_rule: Remain SATELLITE and preserve product spatial/temporal characteristics.
Remain SATELLITE unless a deterministic calculation is explicitly produced from the source.

common_adapter_contract.request: Provider-specific request parameters plus venue identity and observation window.
common_adapter_contract.response: Raw payload reference + normalized observation records + provider metadata.
common_adapter_contract.failure_behavior: Fail closed. No value is promoted to reportable when provenance, time, location, unit, or source integrity is missing.
common_adapter_contract.immutability: Normalized records are append-only; corrections create successor records linked to the superseded observation.
